scope.purpose: Define a source-preserving owner-centered three-grid ladder and a parent-reviewable full-native cost plan from the actual ROOT102/104 initial evidence and an actual same-forcing full836 solver receipt.
scope.read_scope: Metadata-only preparation: XML/JSON receipts, support reports, RunPARTs.csv, Run.out and file stat records. No BI4, VTK payload, HDF5 or particle-array read was performed for this v2 plan.

qualification.reason: ROOT102/104 close an owner-mass and discrete-support initial branch at dp=0.003. They do not establish time integration, output error, flux/no-penetration or numerical qualification.

owner_contract.mass_policy: Use native MassFluid generated for each grid; do not normalize or rescale. The preferred gate is <=1% from 14.58 kg; >2% is a hard failure. A generated count forecast is never a mass gate.

common_scales.position_L_source: Frozen observer contract: dp=0.006 inner source extent; do not scale L with candidate dp.
common_scales.velocity_scale_source: sqrt(9.81 * 0.084), frozen source drawbox depth; owner depth 0.09 is diagnostic only.
common_scales.event_time: UNKNOWN until a source-defined characteristic event is registered; never use output window as event time.

source_binding.control_identity: All selected current-source records must bind the 9a776... forcing file. The historical 6f426... forcing record remains a separate diagnostic and cannot be paired with this ladder.

phase_rule.name: owner_centered_cell_center_sampling
phase_rule.meaning: The continuous owner box and all non-fluid geometry/control remain fixed. Only the cell-center representation, inner fluid selector and half-dp boundary envelope vary with dp.
forbidden: Do not reuse the dp=0.006 selector for another dp and call it owner-centered without actual coordinate QA.
Do not scale observer L, velocity scale, owner mass or event denominator with dp.
Do not infer actual counts, support or mass from arithmetic before GenCase.

strict_owner_centered_candidate_coarse_d.arithmetic_status: REGISTRATION_ONLY_NOT_ACTUAL; these values must be replaced by generated.xml/VTK/receipt facts.
strict_owner_centered_candidate_coarse_d.why_selected: 0.9/0.015, 0.18/0.015 and 0.09/0.015 are integer owner lengths, giving a spacing-separated coarse rung without changing the owner geometry.
strict_owner_centered_candidate_coarse_d.preflight_gate: Run official GenCase with current XML/control identity and -threads:1; then audit actual fluid blocks, MassFluid, finite Idp/coordinates, owner containment and boundary envelope. No solver before this gate.

support_evidence.scope: Current XML/control SHA is recorded; 67500 fluid points were inside the owner closed envelope. This is discrete support evidence only and does not prove physical no-penetration or flux.

current_source_middle_dp0.006.solver_gate: Current-control source join, actual support QA and parent resource review must remain closed before a full-window canary.

support_evidence.scope: 540000 fluid points, GLOBAL_XML_PARTICLE_IDS, all inside the frozen owner envelope. Parent did not independently hash the VTK payload; no no-penetration or flux claim.

actual_owner_fine_dp0.003.solver_gate: Full native run remains parent-dispatch-only after coarse/middle actual QA and storage review; no solver was started by this plan.

existing_current_control_dp0.0075_diagno.reason_not_selected_as_strict_coarse: Its generated fluid selector is inherited from the dp=0.006 inner selector ([−0.447,−0.087,0.003], size [0.894,0.174,0.084]); do not call it owner-centered for dp=0.0075 without an actual coordinate/phase audit.

dp0.0048.interpretation: The +2.958% sample-mass result is a hard mass failure against the frozen 14.58 kg gate. The report records the current forcing identity, but that identity cannot rescue the mass failure; the 15208 points outside its inner selector are not a physical-fate claim. Preserve this record and never use it as the fine rung.

historical_original_dp0.006_control_mism.interpretation: Keep the old original-control record separate. It cannot be paired with current-control ROOT086/ROOT102 sources or used as a current S2 reference.

planning_proxy.basis: Only the actual same-forcing ROOT706 receipt/RunPARTs baseline above; this is a storage planning proxy, not a wall-time or accuracy guarantee.
planning_proxy.frame_formula: Use actual RunPARTs rows. The baseline has 836 rows for [0,8.350016881886734] at -tout:0.01; do not promise 836 rows for a new run until its receipt closes.

actual_dp0.003_reference_proxy.status: PROXY_FROM_ACTUAL_BASELINE; actual solver output must replace this estimate

existing_dp0.0075_diagnostic_proxy.status: PROXY_ONLY; this is not the strict owner-centered coarse rung

new_dp0.015.status: Do not substitute the arithmetic 4320-fluid forecast for actual total particles or storage.

planning_proxy.half_cfl_policy: At the same saved cadence, native bytes are expected to be set by actual particle count, but half-CFL runtime, effective dt, clamp counts and terminal timestamp are UNKNOWN until its own guarded RunPARTs/Run.out/DtAllInfo receipt. Do not infer them from CFL.
planning_proxy.dense_output_policy: A proposed -tout:0.005 run is a separate parent-reviewed request. A nominal 2x frame/storage multiplier is planning-only; actual saved rows and terminal time must replace it. Typed/HDF5/archive bytes are excluded from this native-only estimate.

required_preflight_gates.requirement: Every new Def/XML and forcing input is source-bound to the current XML SHA 116232... and forcing SHA 9a776..., with official GenCase/solver SHA recorded. No historical 6f426 control joins.

Run official GenCase only after parent reservation, using an attempt-contained output root and -threads:1. Verify generated.xml, receipt, actual dp, all fluid blocks/MK counts, MassFluid and total/fixed/fluid counts.
Recompute actual sample mass from generated fluid blocks and compare with 14.58 kg. Preferred <=1%; >2% hard failure. Never change particle mass to pass.

Guarded Fluid/Bound VTK audit must validate finite points, Idp mapping, actual support/owner containment and boundary envelope with stable source/output provenance. Support does not prove no-penetration, flux or particle fate.
Normalized generated XML comparison must show unchanged owner/tank/boundary/motion/forcing semantics; only dp, cell-center phase, inner fluid selector and half-dp boundary envelope may vary.

No full native solver until all selected grids have actual G1-G5 closure, parent UUID/storage reservation, and a fresh attempt root. Each solver must preserve [0,8.350016881886734] and report RunPARTs, Run.out, DtAllInfo and official DTsMin/clamp evidence.

future_solver_shape.same_cfl: Use source-verified effective controls; actual dt remains unknown until RunPARTs/DtAllInfo.
future_solver_shape.half_cfl: Separate overlay changing only registered CFL/logging nodes; no automatic storage/runtime credit.
future_solver_shape.dispatch: Parent root only; this plan creates no solver request and starts no GPU or native array task.

next_actions: Keep ROOT102/104 dp=0.003 as the actual fine initial branch with 14.58 kg and limited owner-envelope support evidence.
Use the strict dp=0.015 owner-centered formula as one new coarse GenCase-only candidate; require actual XML/VTK QA before any solver.
Keep ROOT086 dp=0.006 as the actual middle branch and close current-control/support provenance before solver release.
Retain dp=0.0048 +2.9582696% and the 6f426 historical control as immutable diagnostics; give them no three-grid credit.
If parent releases a canary, use one actual source-bound full window first, replace proxy bytes with terminal receipt/RunPARTs, then review any second grid.
